_: The acceptance corpus (B-196, docs/plans/rebuild-acceptance.md §1 'Case' and 'Class', chunk Q2): one case per line. A pin case is one '// expect:' line of a program the present tree's suite runs against its pins (id pin:<file>#<ordinal>, the line and the pinned text exactly); a test case is one test the suite registers (id test:<module without src/test/ and .ts>:<name>, #2 for a second test of one name in one module). Pins come first by file then ordinal, tests by module then registration. id, kind, file, line, expect, module and name are derived and rewritten by next/tools/corpus.ts --sync; class (null, survives, changes, detail), ruling and becomes (required when class is changes: a decision title of next/decisions.json and the new result), decisions (titles of next/decisions.json) and milestone (1 to 9, required when class is survives or changes) are edited by hand and kept by --sync. Checked by npm run lint:corpus.
